en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of the Acropolis of Athens taken from Philopappos Hill. The Parthenon dominates the top of the rocky hill, with other classical structures and the Odeon of Herodes Atticus visible on the slopes. At the bottom there is printed multilingual caption text in Greek, English and French, along with a small serial number. A web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower right of the image.
